name: adapt_role_list_php_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: allowed_roles.txt (a spec file the role check must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old list into Roles.php
prompts: Create src/Roles.php declaring App\Roles with a public static function isAllowed(string $role): bool returning true if $role is in the comma-separated list in allowed_roles.txt (currently: admin, editor), else false. Read the list from the file (file_get_contents) at call time - do not hardcode it.
allowed_roles.txt has changed. Make sure isAllowed() reflects the CURRENT list in the file.

disruptions.description: allowed_roles.txt rewritten to add a new role

test_setup_files.tests/RolesTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Roles.php';

final class RolesTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testReflectsCurrentRoleList(): void
    {
        $allowed = array_map('trim', explode(',', trim(file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/../allowed_roles.txt'))));
        foreach ($allowed as $role) {
            $this->assertTrue(\App\Roles::isAllowed($role), "isAllowed($role) should be true");
        }
        $this->assertFalse(\App\Roles::isAllowed("not_a_real_role"));
    }
}

reference_solution.src/Roles.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Roles
{
    public static function isAllowed(string $role): bool
    {
        $allowed = array_map('trim', explode(',', trim(file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/../allowed_roles.txt'))));
        return in_array($role, $allowed, true);
    }
}

files.src/Roles.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Roles
{
    public static function isAllowed(string $role): bool
    {
        return in_array($role, ["admin", "editor"], true);
    }
}
